items.text: Chapter 1: Room 1507 Audrey's POV In the muted gloom of the five-star Montclair hotel's fifteenth-floor hallway, I fought to keep the room-service cart from rattling beneath my unsteady grip. A silver tray rested on top, bearing two crystal goblets and a bottle of red wine costly enough to cover several months of rent. Every time the ceiling lights struck the glasses, they flashed like warning signals. The hotel uniform hanging from my shoulders belonged to someone at least a size larger. A strategic arrangement of safety pins had made it passable, though determination had done most of the work. Room 1507 waited a few steps away. Behind that door was the presidential suite. More importantly, Damian Kingsley was inside it. I filled my lungs slowly, willing my pulse to ease. Instead, the entire morning replayed in brutal fragments: a text from a number I didn't recognize, an image loading across my screen, then the nausea that had seized me when the details became clear. Evan was in bed
